en: Black‑and‑white image of a 19th‑century railway station building with arched windows on the ground floor and rectangular windows above. A platform canopy extends along the tracks on the right, with several gas‑style street lamps and a few railway staff and passengers standing around. A clock is mounted over the main entrance, and there is a small cart near the left side of the building. The architecture suggests a Central European station of the late 19th to early 20th century.
